scope: Public reusable source scripts only. Local reference-specific experiments and generated data are intentionally excluded.

statusDefinitions.maintained: Reusable development, analysis, validation or release tool included in the public source scope. Prerequisites still apply.

entries.purpose: Analyze a caller-supplied local video through the running application API and save an editable project plus input/output hashes.
prerequisites: Python dependencies; running local API; user-provided video within upload limits. A clip range must include both start and end.
entries.outputRouting: The API routes videos or prepared clips above 30 seconds to a segmented schemaVersion 2 composition; shorter inputs use a schemaVersion 1 project. Processing segment boundaries are not necessarily source scene cuts.

entries.purpose: Compare actual source frames with visual-qa.mjs screenshots (no accuracy claims).
prerequisites: Fixture videos and visual-qa.mjs rendered PNGs

entries.purpose: Build a labelled side-by-side GIF from caller-supplied original and rendered local videos, preserving timing at the selected GIF frame rate.
prerequisites: Python dependencies; original and rendered videos; source-start matching any analyzed clip offset. No operating-system-specific font path required.

entries.purpose: Independent benchmark videos, drawn without using the reconstruction engine.
prerequisites: Python dependencies; no reference media required

entries.purpose: Start the FastAPI backend on 8000 and the Vite frontend.
prerequisites: npm dependencies; local .venv prepared by npm run setup

entries.purpose: Export annotated vectors with optional bounded contour fitting and caller-defined back surfaces, preserving front-to-back stacks and text.
prerequisites: npm dependencies; Playwright Chromium; app project and caller-defined closed visible-region paths. This does not automatically infer semantic masks or hidden geometry.

entries.purpose: Generate an offline gallery for exported SVG assets with source cuts, editorial sections, selection and visibility toggles.
prerequisites: Manifest emitted by export-elements.mjs

entries.purpose: Shared Git candidate discovery, SHA-256 and public-source inspection used by release-check and package-source.
prerequisites: Git checkout and source files; imported by release-check.mjs and package-source.mjs.

entries.purpose: Validate and render generic object-scene-v1 models as SVG with caller-defined material groups and optional color overrides.
prerequisites: Caller-supplied object-scene-v1 model. This is a JavaScript library, separate from the app project renderer.

entries.purpose: Assemble caller-supplied ellipse/contour/Bezier observations into conservative tracks using metadata dimensions, FPS, frame count and cuts.
prerequisites: Python dependencies; caller-supplied metadata and complete frame observations. No video is directly ingested.

entries.purpose: Package inspected public source into a ZIP and independently unzip/hash every listed source entry before reporting success.
prerequisites: npm dependencies; Git checkout; passing release-file inspection.
limits: Does not include ignored media, caches, generated output or dependencies.

entries.purpose: Dependency-free numeric vector model library with interpolation, projective transforms, validation and SVG rendering; independent from app project and object-scene formats.
prerequisites: Caller-supplied model matching this library schema. See tests/engine/parametric.test.ts for examples.

entries.purpose: Inspect current Git tracked and non-ignored untracked files for public-source scope, file size, selected sensitive patterns and script catalog coverage.
prerequisites: Git checkout or initialized Git folder; public-source manifest/catalog and required source files.
limits: Pattern scan is not a comprehensive secret audit.
Does not stage, commit, create a remote or upload files.

entries.purpose: Export validated app schema1/schema2 project JSON to standalone HTML and optionally render its SVG stage into a duration-checked MP4.
prerequisites: npm dependencies; caller-supplied app project JSON; Playwright Chromium and local Python/imageio-ffmpeg for video output. object-scene-v1 is a different input format.

entries.purpose: Create a local Python environment and install requirements.
prerequisites: Node.js and Python >=3.10; network access for Python package installation

entries.purpose: Exercise the public upload API on independent videos and save review artifacts.
prerequisites: Local running API; generated .data/qa-fixtures/*.mp4

entries.purpose: Render analyzed projects at known source times, independently of the editor UI.
prerequisites: artifacts/qa/*.json from verify-analysis.py; Playwright Chromium

entries.purpose: Dispatch named reusable tasks to their Python/Node entry points and inspect local dependencies without installing them.
prerequisites: Dependencies required by the selected task; Uses local .venv when present; FRAMEFORM_PYTHON is a fallback when .venv is absent.
entries.argumentPolicy: Arguments after the task name are forwarded to the selected script.

entries.purpose: Fit SVG polylines to corner-aware cubic curves with a sampled source-pixel error bound and preserved subpaths.
prerequisites: No extra dependencies; factory also runs in Chromium.

entries.purpose: Fit caller-defined solid surface gradients to visible source SVG colors, preserving geometry and reporting held-out CIELAB DeltaE76.
prerequisites: npm dependencies and Playwright Chromium; reference library and compatible surface regions

entries.purpose: Fit bounded 2/4/8-stop sRGB gradients, select direction by held-out CIELAB error, and retain existing colors when evidence is insufficient.
prerequisites: No additional dependencies

entries.purpose: Compare fixed caller-annotated part ROIs in aligned source, actual rendered and optional baseline stills; report contextual RGB MAE and optional independent visible-source color MAE without shape accuracy claims.
prerequisites: Python dependencies (Pillow and NumPy); opaque aligned equal-sized source/rendered stills and a part-comparison-v1 manifest. Optional full-size binary visible masks must be independent source annotations, not generated geometry.
limits: No automatic segmentation, image registration or temporal alignment.
ROI crops may include foreground occluders and background; visible-mask metrics measure color only.
Does not measure shape IoU or reconstruction accuracy percentages, and does not claim full-video visual review.
